issues.title: Petrol 9-5 fan operation absent, unexpected or operating after ignition-off
issues.cause: DICE controls relay combinations according to Trionic coolant data, A/C inputs and ignition-off afterrun state.
symptoms: fans running after ignition is off
issues.diagnosis_summary: Read valid actual coolant temperature, verify AC equipment, DICE signal and two-speed relay/fan paths; afterrun may be factory-normal for hot coolant.
issues.correction_summary: Correct demonstrated electrical/sensor/cooling defect using full MY2008 WIS; do not bypass relay or retune thresholds.
limits: No fleet-level failure incidence or component replacement approval.
A/C and fan-count restrictions are crucial.
Afterrun alone is not a defect.

issues.title: Coolant temperature sensor circuit fault with fan protective response
issues.cause: Open/shorted or implausible NTC signal or bus coolant data can cause a substituted temperature value and fan failsafe.
symptoms: fan runs with temperature input absent
issues.diagnosis_summary: Check true coolant temperature versus factory Trionic read-value, sensor 5V/reference ground and NTC resistance, connector/harness and DICE communication.
issues.correction_summary: Repair tested faulty sensor or wiring and confirm valid reading and cooling fan control; no universal sensor replacement from code alone.
limits: Factory DTCs are symptom categories, not guaranteed sensor diagnoses.
Substitute coolant temperature may differ materially from physical coolant temperature.

issues.title: Coolant leak or loss of system pressure
issues.cause: Leak at hose, pump seal, cap/expansion tank or other component can reduce pressurization and cause overheating.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Use prescribed cold pressure test above 1 bar, inspect entire system, check cap opening 140–150 kPa and bleed after service.
issues.correction_summary: Repair only confirmed leak source, restore correct coolant ratio and check pressure and fan cycling.
limits: Test over 1 bar is not a demand to exceed safe equipment limits or a replacement cap rating.
Slight pump seal lubrication seep per WIS not equivalent to ongoing volume loss.
No vehicle-specific leakage diagnosis or failure frequency.

gaps.title: Actual electrical wiring diagrams and DICE relay connectors
missing_inputs: Retrieve 2007–09 4-cylinder petrol electrical schematics for engine ECU, coolant NTC, DICE pins 35/53, relay 155/81/396, fuse 15, splice and G locations; check options/market.
gaps.reason: Factory text describes logic and selected terminals, not a circuit-complete wiring drawing.

gaps.title: Fan temperature 99 versus 100 context
missing_inputs: Check revision/calibration and engineering tolerance difference between WIS overview 100°C, detailed fan logic 99°C, and technical data 100±2°C.
gaps.reason: Do not silently choose a single exact temperature or assume a different software calibration.

gaps.title: Coolant engineering acceptance and actual high-temp measurements
missing_inputs: Identify coolant chemistry/mixture, cap pressure test, measured fan/sensor readings, radiator airflow, pump condition and independent gauge accuracy for specific VINs.
gaps.reason: Nominal thresholds and component diagrams cannot predict an old car's thermal behavior.

gaps.title: 2007 and 2009 cooling-system data and service cross-check
missing_inputs: Retrieve separately validated model-year cooling pressure, thermostat, refill and water pump data for MY2007 and MY2009 and inspect production-year/country revisions.
gaps.reason: Full pressure and thermostat tables are recorded from MY2008 only; sources in adjacent year paths not a blanket year extension.

gaps.title: T7 cooling DTC diagnostic trees and sensor replacement identity
missing_inputs: Read P0116–P0119 enable criteria, detailed WIS measurement protocol, EPC sensor OEM part numbers/VIN revisions and verified hardware connector configuration.
gaps.reason: Source-reported DTCs do not justify replacing every faulty-looking sensor or automatically accepting an aftermarket crossfit.

gaps.title: Petrol versus diesel fan controller and coolant flow variants
missing_inputs: Cross-check diesel ECM/UEC multi-speed system, petrol DICE 1-/2-fan arrangement and automatic-cooling provisions without combining them.
gaps.reason: Different engine-control architectures are shown in adjacent WIS tree branches. Mixing them can create unsafe specifications.

gaps.title: Reliability and service evidence
missing_inputs: Find model-year-specific field failure/corrosion data for cap, fan relay, fan resistor, thermostat, radiator, heat exchanger, temperature sensor and pump; verify replacement part supply and repair cost.
gaps.reason: Factory procedure reveals potential fault modes but provides no probability or cost estimate.
